title: Microsoft 365 admin center: Organizational messages can be delivered by email
summary: Hold: the email-location and recipient paths skip choices in the message-creation wizard, including the objective and template. Microsoft documents the Writer role as an authoring requirement, but does not establish that it is the only gate on delivery. The template counts are supported by the feature guide, but the briefing should acknowledge that Microsoft's release notes give different counts.

claims.quote: Organizational Messages now includes Email as a delivery channel, expanding beyond existing surfaces such as the Windows Taskbar, Windows Notifications, Windows Spotlight, and Teams Popovers.

claims.quote: Searched: '"organizational messages" "email" "license" "price"'; opened the organizational messages guide and FAQ, including advanced-feature requirements. Neither publishes an email price, meter or billing unit; search results on Azure email pricing concern another product.

claims.claim: Show all > Reports > Organizational messages > Create a message > Location is the complete route to selecting email.
claims.quote:
Objective: Select the nature or purpose of your new message. Options include Adoption, onboarding, Sustainability and Tech updates.
Location: ... choose where your message is displayed to users.
claims.fix: Replace the path in front matter and the rendered row with 'Show all > Reports > Organizational messages > Top actions > Create a message > Objective > Location'. Objective is a choice before Location; the guide also warns that pre-made messages are not available for every objective. Source: https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-365/admin/misc/organizational-messages-microsoft-365.

claims.quote: Searched: '"organizational messages" "Graph" "API" "create"', '"organizationalMessage" "graph" "beta"', and 'organizational messages email create schedule cancel Microsoft Graph API PowerShell'; opened the guide and FAQ. No relevant organizational-message creation API was found.

claims.claim: Show all > Reports > Organizational messages > Create a message > Recipients is the complete route to choosing recipients.
claims.quote: Objective: Select the nature or purpose ... Location: ... choose where ... Template: Choose the format of the message. You can either use a pre-made message from Microsoft or create your own. ... Customize: ... Recipients: Set the groups
claims.fix: Replace the path in front matter and the rendered row with 'Show all > Reports > Organizational messages > Top actions > Create a message > Objective > Location > Template > Customize > Recipients'. This restores the documented wizard sequence and its objective, delivery-location and template choices. Source: https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-365/admin/misc/organizational-messages-microsoft-365.
